data.name: Fikhar
data.long_meaning: The one who understands, comprehends or knows something. Derived from the Arabic verb 'fakara', which means 'to understand' or 'to perceive'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages intellectual growth and curiosity, instilling a thirst for knowledge and understanding.
data.numerology_meaning: A harmonious and balanced name that promotes love, beauty, and creativity.

in_arabic.name: فخار
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفخر، الشخص الفخور بنفسه
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فخار مشتق من جذر الفخر، و يعني الشخص الذي يفخر بنفسه و بشأنه، و الفخار هو أيضا نوع من الأواني المصنوعة من الطين المحروق، مما يعطيها قيمة و جمالا، و هذا الاسم يوحي بالعزة و الكرامة

in_urdu.name: فخار
in_urdu.meaning: فخر کرنے والا، خود پر فخر کرنے والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: فخار نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فخر کرنے والا یا خود پر فخر کرنے والا شخص، یہ نام عزت و سربلندی کے احساس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر اسلامی ناموں کے سلسلے میں کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फखार
in_hindi.meaning: फखर करने वाला, अपने आप पर गर्व करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: फखार नाम का अर्थ है फखर करने वाला या अपने आप पर गर्व करने वाला, यह नाम आत्म-सम्मान और गरिमा की भावना को दर्शाता है, और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक अच्छे नाम के रूप में किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: فخار
in_pashto.meaning: د فخر کولو شخص، هغه کسي چې په خپل ځان فخر کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: فخار نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې د فخر کولو شخص یا هغه کسي چې په خپل ځان فخر کوي، دا نوم د عزت او کرامت احساس څرګندوي، او د افغان او پښتون دوديز نومونو په منځ کې يې ځای لري

in_english.name: Fikhar
in_english.meaning: One who takes pride in himself, a person with self-respect
in_english.long_meaning: Fikhar is an Arabic name derived from the root 'F-KH-R', meaning one who takes pride in himself or a person with self-respect, this name reflects a sense of dignity and self-esteem, and is used across various Muslim cultures as a symbol of honor and pride

It is highly valued in most Islamic societies where education is considered a fundamental aspect of personal growth and development. Individuals named Fikhar are often looked upon as scholars, philosophers, or thinkers, carrying a high level of respect and authority within their communities. This name is also a reminder of the importance of striving for knowledge and understanding in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, Fikhar represents a deep spiritual understanding of the divine and the world. It is a reminder to seek knowledge not just for worldly gains, but for a closer connection with God. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The seeking of knowledge is an obligation for every Muslim" [Bukhari, Debate between Ibn Umar and Abdullah bin Abbas (1/3)]. The spiritual significance of the name Fikhar lies in the pursuit of knowledge as a means to attain a deeper connection with the Divine and lead a more enlightened life.
